name: Est Global Apparel Co.,Ltd
summary: Est Global Apparel Co.,Ltd, headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan, is an apparel manufacturer and retailer that operates both domestically and in international markets. Established in 1987, the company specializes in a diverse range of clothing categories, including athleisure wear, functional garments, seamless apparel, and loungewear. Its current name was adopted in August 2016, having previously traded as Free Power Energy Co.,Ltd.
